items.description: EU Vetted is a directory of EU and privacy-first SaaS alternatives to US software; each listing shows ownership signal, hosting country, sub-processors, CLOUD Act exposure and factual compliance signals as independent signals
Category pages listing EU/privacy-first SaaS tools by software type (password managers, VPN, CRM, web analytics, etc., 26 categories)
Alternatives to US tools: side-by-side comparisons of European alternatives with factual compliance signals
Scoring methodology explaining how compliance signals and CLOUD Act exposure tiers are assigned
llms-full.txt single-file full content dump for LLMs

Ownership signal values: eu_owned, eu_hq_us_funded, eu_subsidiary_us_parent, us_owned, other; compliance signals (EU/adequacy hosting, EU ownership, CLOUD Act exposure, public DPA, sub-processor disclosure, E2E encryption, third-party certifications) are each marked verified / not / not-assessed

CLOUD Act exposure tiers: direct (US-incorporated), material (EU entity with US parent or US hyperscaler primary storage), minor (EU-hosted with one or two transient US sub-processors like Cloudflare CDN or Stripe, no data at rest), none (no US sub-processors of consequence)
Funding transparency page: how the site is funded, what money cannot buy, and current affiliate partnerships
Editorial standards: what is editorial vs paid and how conflicts of interest are handled
Featured listings are paid placements, but compliance signals are independent of payment and never paid for
Hosting country is determined by data-center IP ASN, not corporate HQ; Cloudflare US in front of an EU SaaS counts as US exposure for plain HTTP; sub-processors are weighted heavily
A DPA must be publicly linked; DPAs only available on enterprise plans are marked not publicly available
Listings are re-verified quarterly and show a visible 'last verified' timestamp
Site is available in English (default, no prefix), German (/de/) and French (/fr/)
